request: What impact did passing Obamacare have on the federal budget?

reply.reply: The original CBO/JCT projection was that the Affordable Care Act would reduce federal deficits by $210 billion over FY2012–FY2021 (CRS R41664, PDF p. 7). The same projection estimated $1,390 billion in gross costs for the law’s insurance-coverage expansion over that period; gross costs are not the net deficit impact. These are estimates cited in a 2012 CRS report, not evidence of the actual budget outcome. See the [brief](output/briefs/case-20261021-171308-dc15.html) for details.
reply.reasoning: The verified source directly provides the original CBO/JCT deficit projection and separate gross coverage costs. The brief explicitly cautions that these do not measure realized budget outcomes.
